deadline.value: Fall applications for the PhD close February 1.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must find a faculty supervisor who confirms they will supervise you before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must identify a supervisor before submitting their application and the supervisor must confirm that they are willing to supervise the applicant

funding.value: Memorial describes competitive funding packages; the program lists a PhD amount of $20,000 a year.
funding.quote: Memorial University offers competitive funding packages to academically eligible full-time graduate students, both Canadian and international, in all eligible research programs

entry_route.value: PhD entry normally requires an MSc from a recognized institution.
entry_route.quote: Normally, students entering the Ph.D. program in Environmental Science will have a M.Sc. degree from an institution recognized by the Senate

notes: Interdisciplinary program run across faculties; the calendar says the supervisory committee must include members of at least two departments. Physical oceanography is part of the Physics and Physical Oceanography record.
